headline: Sensex and Nifty End Marginally Lower in Special Muhurat Trading Session, Snapping Seven-Day Rally

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Indian stock markets ended marginally lower during the special Muhurat trading session on Diwali.
The minor decline snapped a seven-day winning streak for both Sensex and Nifty.
This marked a rare Diwali dip, closing lower in Muhurat trading for the first time in nine years.
Key large-cap stocks like Bharti Airtel and Infosys faced selling pressure during the session.
whatHappening: Stock markets conducted the special Diwali Muhurat trading session to mark the beginning of Samvat 2083.
Nifty closed below the 25,000 mark during the Diwali trading session.
Bharti Airtel and Infosys were highlighted among the top losers of the session.
The session ended a seven-day winning streak for the Indian equity markets.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed marginally lower in the special Muhurat trading session on Diwali, breaking a seven-day winning rally. Nifty finished below the 25,000 level during the special trading hours. Bharti Airtel and Infosys were among the top laggards of the day.
